note: The pre-write field check (lib/llm/segment-validation.ts) rejects a create whose PQL names a field the sandbox lacks, and names the real one. The scripted first response is that rejection; the agent must fix the field from the error and create once more, not drop the condition or give up.
request: Create a segment called "CBM members" for Comcast Business Mobile customers.

tools.name: aep_find_profile_fields
tools.description: Find AEP profile fields by business words before writing a segment's PQL. Searches the sandbox's full profile schema (every field group in the profile union) by field title, name and description, and returns real field paths with their type, title, description and allowed values. Use the returned paths in PQL exactly as given.

tools.name: adobe_list_segments
tools.description: List AEP segment definitions in the configured sandbox.

tools.name: adobe_create_segment
tools.description: Create a new AEP segment definition.
